title: H6, round 32: the longer-trained and the wider black box beside round 31's split and black box, validation links
description: Round 32 (exp-net2-r32-blackbox-more-296) continued each of round 31's hidden-256 black boxes for 120 more iterations (r32-cont256, 180 in all, its policy as evaluated at its last iteration, iter119/policy-updated.onnx) and trained a fresh hidden-512 black box for round 31's 60 iterations (r32-w512, iter059/policy-updated.onnx). They run on the validation links at campaign seed 21 (the five families) and among 2 and 4 copies, beside round 31's split (r31-net1) and hidden-256 black box (r31-raw256) at iteration 59 and the fixed rule at u = 0.25 on net1 v7 (rule-v7), all taken from exp-blackbox-val-295. Reading, stated in run 296 before the results: if neither round 32 arm comes within 0.02 of r31-net1 on the five-family mean over three seeds, the split's lead holds against a larger and a longer-trained black box; if r32-cont256 does, the lead is the split's sample efficiency. Nothing is chosen.
prepare: mkdir -p "$OUT/p"; cp "$IN/x/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx" "$OUT/p/rule-v7.onnx"; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/p/rule-v7.onnx"); for s in 1 2 3; do for a in net1 raw256; do cp "$IN/x/p/r31-$a-s$s.onnx" "$OUT/p/"; P+=(--policy "r31-$a-s$s=$OUT/p/r31-$a-s$s.onnx"); done; cp "$IN/q/ppo-r32-cont256-s$s/iter119/policy-updated.onnx" "$OUT/p/r32-cont256-s$s.onnx"; P+=(--policy "r32-cont256-s$s=$OUT/p/r32-cont256-s$s.onnx"); cp "$IN/q/ppo-r32-w512-s$s/iter059/policy-updated.onnx" "$OUT/p/r32-w512-s$s.onnx"; P+=(--policy "r32-w512-s$s=$OUT/p/r32-w512-s$s.onnx"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 26 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
